python_code:
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.assets.metadata.asset_metadata_enricher import get_asset_metadata_enricher
from src.runtime.assets.metadata.asset_semantic_mapper import get_asset_semantic_mapper
from src.runtime.assets.schema import AssetDescriptor
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Asset_Metadata(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_asset_metadata"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("asset_descriptor_json", "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("action",                "string", widget_type="text", default="enrich")
        self.add_input("assets_json",           "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_output("enriched_asset_json",   "string")
        self.add_output("inferred_environments", "string")
        self.add_output("inferred_style",        "string")
        self.add_output("semantic_profile_json", "string")
        self.add_output("batch_results_json",    "string")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        action     = (inputs.get("action") or "enrich").strip().lower()
        asset_json = inputs.get("asset_descriptor_json") or ""
        batch_json = inputs.get("assets_json") or ""
        enricher   = get_asset_metadata_enricher()
        mapper     = get_asset_semantic_mapper()

        enriched_asset_json   = "{}"
        inferred_environments = "[]"
        inferred_style        = ""
        semantic_profile_json = "{}"
        batch_results_json    = "[]"

        try:
            if action in ("enrich", "semantic_profile") and asset_json.strip():
                raw = json.loads(asset_json)
                asset = AssetDescriptor.from_dict(raw) if isinstance(raw, dict) else None
                if asset:
                    enricher.enrich_asset(asset)
                    enriched_asset_json   = json.dumps(asset.to_dict(), default=str)
                    inferred_environments = json.dumps(asset.environment_suitability)
                    inferred_style        = asset.style or ""
                    if action == "semantic_profile":
                        profile = mapper.build_semantic_profile(asset)
                        semantic_profile_json = json.dumps(profile.to_dict(), default=str)
                    self.log_info(f"Enriched '{asset.name}': envs={asset.environment_suitability}")

            elif action == "batch" and batch_json.strip():
                raw_list = json.loads(batch_json)
                if isinstance(raw_list, list):
                    assets = [AssetDescriptor.from_dict(r) for r in raw_list if isinstance(r, dict)]
                    profiles = mapper.batch_map(assets)
                    batch_results_json = json.dumps([p.to_dict() for p in profiles], default=str)
                    self.log_info(f"Batch mapped {len(profiles)} assets.")

        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"AssetMetadata error: {exc}")

        return {
            "enriched_asset_json":   enriched_asset_json,
            "inferred_environments": inferred_environments,
            "inferred_style":        inferred_style,
            "semantic_profile_json": semantic_profile_json,
            "batch_results_json":    batch_results_json,
            "exec_out": True,
        }

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Asset_Metadata
